final_text:
Fixed the shared eviction logic in `Cache.__setitem__`.

The cache was evicting when the prospective size was equal to `maxsize` due to a `>=` condition. Changed it to `>` so caches can now fill exactly to their configured maximum, including custom `getsizeof` values.
